requirements.description: User prefers proximity to public transport ('near public transport'). Value set to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
The project is a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is essential. Value set to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area >= 850 is applied as a direct threshold.

The user is searching in Turin. The provided data distribution shows all records share comune_code L219, which is the cadastral code for the municipality of Turin. This is an inferred mapping from the dataset, not a city name converted by guesswork; the geographic filter is otherwise the Location Agent's responsibility, so this may be redundant with it.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be A1, A2, A3, A4, B or C. Floor area, capacity for 60 people and proximity to public transport are outside the available columns and were not filtered.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE comune_code = 'L219' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the estates in comune L219 (Turin) with surface_area of at least 850 sqm, energy class A1 to C, and mobility and education scores of at least 71 and 75. Applies a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892. Results are sorted by distance from that point, nearest first. No property_type filter is applied because the extracted requirements do not include one.
